{{External|rs}} {{HasTask|Birds}} {{Otheruses|def=no|the NPC|Rooster (Nigel)}} {{Redirect|Cock|the slayer creature|Cockatrice}} {{Infobox Monster |version1 = Level 2 |version2 = Level 3 |name = Rooster |image = [[File:Rooster.png|160px]] |release1 = [[29 November]] [[2004]] |release2 = [[9 August]] [[2004]] |update1 = Throne Of Miscellania |update2 = Death Plateau Quest |members = Yes |combat1 = 2 |combat2 = 3 |size = 1 |examine = He rules the, er, roost. |xpbonus = 0 |max hit1 = 0 |max hit2 = 1 |aggressive = No |poisonous = No |attack style = [[Stab]] |attack speed = 4 |respawn = 25 |slayxp1 = 5 |slayxp2 = 7 |cat = Birds |assignedby = turael,spria |hitpoints1 = 5 |hitpoints2 = 7 |att1 = 1 |att2 = 2 |str1 = 1 |str2 = 2 |def = 1 |mage = 1 |range = 1 |attbns1 = -47 |attbns2 = -20 |strbns1 = -42 |strbns2 = -20 |amagic = 0 |mbns = 0 |arange = 0 |rngbns = 0 |dstab = -42 |dslash = -42 |dcrush = -42 |dmagic = -42 |dlight = -42 |dstandard = -42 |dheavy = -42 |poisonresistance = 100 |venomresistance = 100 |immunecannon = No |immunethrall = No |id1 = 3663 |id2 = 1175 }} A '''rooster''' is a low-level monster that is very similar to a [[chicken]], and indeed they are found together. Specifically, players can find at least one in [[Tenzing]]'s yard on [[Death Plateau (location)|Death Plateau]]. There is also a rooster in the chicken pen in [[Rellekka]] and in [[Miscellania]] market. The attackable ones are members-only, but there is a [[Rooster (Nigel)|rooster]] in the farm near [[Falador]] standing on the top of the box in the chicken pen even on a [[free-to-play]] world. It looks exactly like the [[Evil Chicken]], a former [[random event]] and a boss monster in the [[quest]] [[Recipe for Disaster]].
